text_block_list.text:
A piece of fan mail arrived for 
Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaa...! A fan letter... for me...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really alright? For someone like 
me, who isn't a symbol of good luck or 
anything, to receive a letter...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A fan letter is an item of immense 
spiritual power! Let us enshrine it at 
once, yes, let us do so!

With that said, she enshrined the fan 
letter in a corner of the Trainer's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, praise be, praise be~! Please 
continue to watch over little old me~!

In any case, the support from her fans 
seemed to raise her motivation.
